Short context includes 272,000 input tokens; above 272,000 tokens the long-context rates apply to the entire request, including cached prompt tokens. Global processing and US data residency are supported; EU and other non-US regional processing are unsupported. Regional data-residency endpoints retain the published 10% uplift. Default usage-tier rate limits are Build 500,000 TPM, Launch 1,000,000 TPM, and Grow 5,000,000 TPM. Endpoint eligibility, service-tier binding, and TPM limits are descriptive, not programmatically enforced by this pricing contract.
